messages.content: 尋找兩家電影院，位於聖地牙哥附近，提供下午5點的《天能》和晚上7點半的《007生死交戰》場次。

function.name: find_movie_showing
function.description: Find local movie theatres and their schedule for a specific movie Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. San Diego, CA

message.reasoning:
The user wants to find two movie theaters near San Diego that have showtimes: 5pm for Tenet (天能) and 7:30pm for 007生死交戰 (No Time To Die). We need to use the function find_movie_showing. The function expects location: string, movie: "Tenet" | "No Time To Die"[], time: string[]. So we need to call the function twice? Actually we need to find two theaters. We can call the function with location "San Diego, CA", movie "Tenet", time ["17:00"] to get theaters showing Tenet at 5pm. Then call again with movie "No Time To Die", time ["19:30"] to get theaters showing that at 7:30pm. But the user wants two theaters that provide both showtimes? Or two separate theaters: one for Tenet at 5pm, another for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. The phrasing: "尋找兩家電影院，位於聖地牙哥附近，提供下午5點的《天能》和晚上7點半的《007生死交戰》場次。" Means "Find two movie theaters near San Diego that offer 5pm Tenet and 7:30pm No Time To Die showtimes." It could mean find two theaters that each have those showtimes? Or find two theaters: one for Tenet at 5pm, one for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. Likely the latter: find two theaters that have those showtimes. So we need to find theaters that have Tenet at 5pm and theaters that have No Time To Die at 7:30pm. So we need to call the function twice.

We need to provide the function calls. The function signature: find_movie_showing({location: string, movie: "Tenet" | "No Time To Die"[], time: string[]}). So we need to pass movie as array? The type says movie: "Tenet" | "No Time To Die"[], but that seems wrong: maybe movie is an array of strings? The type is ambiguous. But we can pass movie: ["Tenet"] or movie: ["No Time To Die"]. Let's pass movie: ["Tenet"].

Time: string[]: we pass ["17:00"].

Similarly for No Time To Die: time ["19:30"].

We need to call the function twice. We'll produce two function calls.
